mentions.name: Breastfeeding tracker for Garmin devices
mentions.description: This app tracks breastfeeding sessions on Garmin devices and is already released with over 1,000 downloads. A companion app is planned to extend functionality with more insights and breastfeeding tips double-checked with professionals to help young parents nursing their newborns.
mentions.problem: New parents need support, insights, and reliable guidance while breastfeeding their newborn children.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am currently working on a breastfeeding tracker for Garmin devices. It is already released a time ago, but I want to include a companion app for this app.
